question: What fourfold group of principles must be meditated upon at the dissolution of the three parts?
premises: The threefold division reaches a state of dissolution.
A group of principles is the object of meditation.
This group is specified as fourfold.
inference: At the dissolution of the three parts, the practitioner should meditate on the fourfold group of principles.
uncertainties: The source token tripakṣakṣayagaṃ? includes a question mark whose editorial status is unclear.
The exact meaning of tripakṣakṣayagaṃ is uncertain.
plain_english: One should meditate on the fourfold group of principles as reaching the dissolution of the three parts.
